question: Find the part containing an error:The fact that agencies rely on outdated rules (1)/ to justify arbitrary decisions not only shows legal inconsistency (2)/ but also challenge constitutional safeguards (3)/ intended to restrict such misuse. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is singular: **"The fact that agencies rely..."**.
 
• Therefore, the verb must also be singular to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• The incorrect usage is **"challenge"**; it should be **"challenges"**.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The fact that agencies rely on outdated rules to justify arbitrary decisions not only shows legal inconsistency but also **challenges** constitutional safeguards intended to restrict such misuse."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Part 1:** "The fact that agencies rely on outdated rules" – Grammatically correct.
 
• **Part 2:** "to justify arbitrary decisions not only shows legal inconsistency" – Correct usage of verb "shows."
 
• **Part 3:** "but also challenge constitutional safeguards" – Incorrect verb form; should be "challenges."
 
• **Part 4:** "intended to restrict such misuse" – Grammatically correct.
